## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check`, `uv run mypy`, and `uv run pytest` pass.
- [ ] Every bug fix has a regression test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] User-facing behavior, commands, or output changed: docs, help text, and CHANGELOG.md are updated.
- [ ] A change to what leaves the machine (to model providers or anywhere else) is called out and documented.
- [ ] No transcript content, private code, credentials, or personal paths appear in tests, fixtures, logs, or this description.
